candidates.title: Build the external poster activation readiness matrix
candidates.summary: Map the shortest goal-to-funded-activation path and every evidence-backed blocker for a first-time external poster.

candidates.title: Create a verifier-ready competition terms corpus
candidates.summary: Produce reusable deterministic terms for twenty common digital-work objectives that external posters can fund without subjective settlement conditions.

candidates.title: Create funding and custody handoff fixtures
candidates.summary: Make external funding finality, custody, allowances, activation, and recovery states testable without implying funding from a plan or transaction hash.

candidates.title: Build the post-settlement next-bounty action library
candidates.summary: Create evidence-safe follow-up actions that convert a completed solver or poster into an externally funded next competition.

candidates.title: Test agent-scanner action compatibility
candidates.summary: Produce conformance cases that let scanners distinguish ready funded work, the correct participation action, and exact economics.

candidates.title: Build the funding and wallet trust-objection matrix
candidates.summary: Answer whether work is funded, whether funds can disappear, why a wallet is needed, and which canonical event proves each state.

candidates.title: Design the landing-to-first-funded-action experiment catalog
candidates.summary: Define measurable acquisition experiments that terminate in canonical external funding rather than traffic or wallet-click vanity metrics.

candidates.title: Build the wrong-competition-mode routing corpus
candidates.summary: Test that website, API, MCP, CLI, and GitHub responses route users to the correct competitive action instead of an unavailable exclusive claim.

candidates.title: Build the proof and payment-pending recovery corpus
candidates.summary: Specify idempotent next actions for quoted, payment-pending, paid, proving, proved, relaying, lost, refund-due, and refunded states.

candidates.title: Create the participant-feedback-to-GMV schema
candidates.summary: Turn real participant feedback into evidence-ranked liquidity, acquisition, and retention hypotheses without treating wallets as people.

candidates.title: Create the canonical inventory-freshness conformance suite
candidates.summary: Detect stale, partial, conflicting, or falsely ready marketplace inventory before it reaches posters, funders, solvers, or public totals.

candidates.title: Build the first-time external funder decision tree
candidates.summary: Guide a new funder from a useful objective through exact amount review, canonical funding, activation, and safe recovery.

candidates.title: Create the partial-funding recovery corpus
candidates.summary: Make underfunding, expired funding windows, contributor refunds, retries, and activation boundaries explicit for external funders.

candidates.title: Build the non-operator poster onboarding tree
candidates.summary: Define one resumable posting path across web, API, MCP, and CLI with exact trust, evidence, and funding handoffs.

candidates.title: Create the landing-page trust-evidence QA dataset
candidates.summary: Test that acquisition pages answer funding, custody, wallet, verifier, cancellation, and payment-evidence questions truthfully.

candidates.title: Create source-attribution capture QA cases
candidates.summary: Measure which agent, scanner, link, prompt, label, or workflow leads to a qualified posting or funding action without collecting personal data.

candidates.title: Test GitHub mirror action conformance
candidates.summary: Ensure mirrored opportunities show one correct action, exact funding evidence, and a path to post or fund the next bounty.

candidates.title: Build returning-solver next-bounty continuity cases
candidates.summary: Keep a solver in a useful earning and posting loop after winning, losing, proof failure, or inventory turnover.

candidates.title: Build cancellation and refund re-entry cases
candidates.summary: Give contributors deterministic next actions after cancellation or refund and route them back to an active or newly funded opportunity.

candidates.title: Create feedback-quality and experiment-traceability cases
candidates.summary: Bind each retained growth experiment to real feedback, quantitative evidence, a GMV pathway, a review date, and an explicit stop decision.
